chapter: Chicago friends: Tesch, Stacy and Wettling
title: Classical music Bix introduced to the Chicagoans
summary: Freeman recalls listening to Stravinsky, Ravel, Debussy and others through Bix, a fine pianist.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Oh, yes, you know, in those days, we listened to music that had nothing to do with jazz as many of the great players had, black or white. We listened to people like Stravinsky, Jacque Ibert, Ravel, Debussy,
Scriabin, Honegger, Scrivener, Hunager, Gustav Holtz (phonetic), the lot and we

were introduced to this music by Bix, and played it all, who could play much of this music on the piano. You see, people don't know -- they think of Bix as being just a great cornet player, but he was a marvelous pianist.
I know, Jess was always saying what a marvelous pianist he was.
